blocks.raw: ## 1.1 Add a new standard document type called KYC\_VERIFICATION\_INFO to the users object on Create User & Update User endpoints
blocks.text: 1.1 Add a new standard document type called KYC_VERIFICATION_INFO to the users object on Create User & Update User endpoints

blocks.raw: #### **Description -**  We are introducing a dedicated object for KYC as verification information under the /users endpoint where partners will send data to evidence KYC Verification.
blocks.text: Description -  We are introducing a dedicated object for KYC as verification information under the /users endpoint where partners will send data to evidence KYC Verification.

blocks.raw: ## 1.2 Also add an optional fields block customFields to allow adding up to 5 extra custom entries.

blocks.raw: #### **Description -**The size of these custom entries should follow the same rules as the metadata entries map we use in other places.
blocks.text: Description -The size of these custom entries should follow the same rules as the metadata entries map we use in other places.

blocks.raw: ## 2.1 Add statusReason whenever DriveWealth or the partner changes the account status
blocks.text: 2.1 Add statusReason whenever DriveWealth or the partner changes the account status

blocks.raw: #### Existing Feature - Current account status change feature doesn't capture the process and individual who initiated the status change .
blocks.text: Existing Feature - Current account status change feature doesn't capture the process and individual who initiated the status change .

blocks.raw: #### For example: The reason behind status change to OPEN\_NO\_NEW\_TRADE is not evident whether it is because of Payment failure, KYC failure or PDT restrictions. Can we re-open the account. Similarly if the account is Frozen we don't know the reason behind the change in status whether it was due to FINRA notice or Asset transfer.
blocks.text: For example: The reason behind status change to OPEN_NO_NEW_TRADE is not evident whether it is because of Payment failure, KYC failure or PDT restrictions. Can we re-open the account. Similarly if the account is Frozen we don't know the reason behind the change in status whether it was due to FINRA notice or Asset transfer.

blocks.raw: #### What is improving? - As part of the change we are capturing statusReason field in the accounts PATCH API which will track the reason behind the status change. Currently we have a field namely closingReason which is primarily used when we close an account. The closingReason field will be deprecated and statusReason need to be utilized to capture the account closing reason.

> 📘 Good to know
>
> 1. if statusReason is not passed then OTHER should be by default
> 2. If Partner has changed the status then they can change the next status.
> 3. DW ops should have full access to change any status. Even if the status was updated by the partner

> 5. Reasons available to Partners to choose from at this time:
>    1. **DUPLICATE\_ACCOUNT**
>    2. **PARTNER\_RESTRICTED**

blocks.raw: #### **What is improving?** - This quick fix will improve the time it takes to identify PDT accounts when the market opens. We will be able to identify accounts with PDT violations within 5 minutes delay of market open. Once this threshold is met, the goal is to lower this time to a shorter amount.

blocks.raw: #### **Description -** This new endpoint  will replace the need for DriveWealth to send several email communications to customers to deliver the annual audited financial statement, privacy notice, BCP, updates to customer agreements, or really any official documentation that should be delivered to the customer for regulatory purposes.
blocks.text: Description - This new endpoint  will replace the need for DriveWealth to send several email communications to customers to deliver the annual audited financial statement, privacy notice, BCP, updates to customer agreements, or really any official documentation that should be delivered to the customer for regulatory purposes.

> * Trading Disclosure - Update
> * Regulatory Insert
> * Account Notification - Important Information
> * Cyber Security Notification
